Game Overview

Red Riding Hood Run is a adventure title where dash through the forest as Red Riding Hood, skillfully avoiding wolves and obstacles. Collect baskets to climb the leaderboard in this easy-to-play, hard-to-master adventure. With endless challenges and addictive gameplay, you'll have hours of thrilling fun trying to set a new high score.

Red Riding Hood Run keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Dash through the forest as Red Riding Hood, skillfully avoiding wolves and obstacles. With endless challenges and addictive gameplay, you'll have hours of thrilling fun trying to set a new high score.
